description: The REFUSAL of `duplicate` of an entity diagram node (ODC lane). The import rule of the diagram (AllowImportOf) only accepts a node pasted together with the source of its entity and once per entity: the node copied alone is refused by the same diagram and by any other. The kernel says so and tells to put the entity in the diagram with create IEntityDiagramNode.
expectError: duplicate: IEntityDiagram 'DupDiagramB' refuses this IEntityDiagramNode by its own import rule
